cohort: 525 SARS-CoV-2 positive women who gave birth in Italy between February 25th and July 31st, 2020
finding: While there was an initial trend towards 'better safe than sorry' care choices for SARS-CoV-2 positive women giving birth, peripartum care indicators improved over time, and both separated and non-separated infants of SARS-CoV-2 positive mothers had good outcomes.
mod_finding: The average caesarean section rate remained stable compared to the national figure.
